_schema.name: _migrations
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _migrations (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      applied_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00'))
    )

_schema.name: users
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      phone TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00'))
    )

_schema.name: idx_users_email
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email)

_schema.name: claim
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE claim (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      claim_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      total_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
      service_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      provider_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      check_item TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted',
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
    )

_schema.name: idx_claim_user
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_claim_user ON claim(user_id)

_schema.name: claim_line_item
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE claim_line_item (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL,
      amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES claim(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

_schema.name: idx_claim_line_item_claim
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_claim_line_item_claim ON claim_line_item(claim_id)

_schema.name: claim_attachment
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE claim_attachment (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      filename TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES claim(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

_schema.name: idx_claim_attachment_claim
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_claim_attachment_claim ON claim_attachment(claim_id)

_schema.name: provider
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE provider (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      district TEXT NOT NULL,
      distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
      network_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_network',
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00'))
    )

_schema.name: provider_service
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE provider_service (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      provider_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      check_item TEXT NOT NULL,
      service_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      cost INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES provider(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      UNIQUE(provider_id, check_item)
    )

_schema.name: idx_provider_service_provider
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_provider_service_provider ON provider_service(provider_id)

_schema.name: appointment_slot
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE appointment_slot (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      provider_service_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      end_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      is_available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (provider_service_id) REFERENCES provider_service(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

_schema.name: idx_appointment_slot_service
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_appointment_slot_service ON appointment_slot(provider_service_id)

_schema.name: appointment
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE appointment (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      provider_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      slot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      provider_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      service_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
      check_item TEXT NOT NULL,
      slot_start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      slot_end_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      cost_snapshot INTEGER NOT NULL,
      distance_km_snapshot REAL NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed',
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES provider(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      FOREIGN KEY (slot_id) REFERENCES appointment_slot(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

_schema.name: idx_appointment_user
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_appointment_user ON appointment(user_id)

_schema.name: idx_appointment_slot
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_appointment_slot ON appointment(slot_id)

_schema.name: insurance_plan
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE insurance_plan (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      code TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT,
      effective_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
      premium_monthly INTEGER NOT NULL,
      deductible INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      UNIQUE(code, effective_year)
    )

_schema.name: plan_benefit
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_benefit (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      benefit_category TEXT NOT NULL,
      coverage_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      coverage_value INTEGER,
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES insurance_plan(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

_schema.name: idx_plan_benefit_plan
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_plan_benefit_plan ON plan_benefit(plan_id)

_schema.name: current_policy
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE current_policy (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
      FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES insurance_plan(id)
    )

_schema.name: idx_current_policy_user
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_current_policy_user ON current_policy(user_id)

_schema.name: idx_current_policy_active
_schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_current_policy_active ON current_policy(user_id) WHERE status = 'active'

_schema.name: plan_selection
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_selection (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      year INTEGER NOT NULL,
      plan_code_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
      plan_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
      deductible_snapshot INTEGER NOT NULL,
      premium_snapshot INTEGER NOT NULL,
      selected_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-04-03 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES insurance_plan(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

_schema.name: idx_plan_selection_user
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_plan_selection_user ON plan_selection(user_id)
